ftbchunks.zoom_warning: Maximum zoom is limited due to memory limitations
ftbchunks.appearance.own_claimed_chunks_: Show your own claimed blocks on the map
ftbchunks.waypoints.death_waypoint_autor: Automatically delete distance from death point
If >0, then when the distance between you and the death point is less than this set value, the death point will be automatically deleted.
ftbchunks.waypoints.waypoint_focus_dista: How close the player's crosshair needs to be to the waypoint before the name is displayed
ftbchunks.waypoints.waypoint_focus_scale: How much does focusing on the waypoint increase?
ftbchunks.advanced.memory.region_release:
For 512x512 regions that have not been accessed recently, the timeout in seconds for releasing data
Smaller values mean less memory usage but require more disk access because freed regions are reloaded
Set to 0 to disable the release of zone data
ftbchunks.advanced.memory.autorelease_on: Automatically release areas when closing the map

When closing the big map, the area data will be automatically released to this amount.
Smaller values mean less memory usage but require more disk access because freed regions are reloaded
Set to 0 to disable the release of zone data
ftbchunks.advanced.memory.max_zoom_const: Limit the maximum zoom of the map

When True, the map's maximum zoom is limited by the number of areas explored and the amount of available memory
If this is bothersome, set it to False
ftbchunks.minimap.show_player_when_unloc: Show player when unlocking north direction
ftbchunks.minimap.font_scale.tooltip: It is recommended to maintain a multiple of 0.5
ftbchunks.minimap.proportional.tooltip:
When True, the minimap size is proportional to 10% of the screen width (can be modified through the scale setting)
When False, the size is fixed regardless of screen resolution.
ftbchunks.no_server_mod: FTB Chunks needs to be installed on the server
ftbchunks.already_claimed: The block has been claimed by %s
ftbchunks.gui.hold_alt_for_dates: Hold Alt key: Display absolute time
ftbchunks.gui.mouse_wheel_expiry: Mouse wheel: Adjust force loading expiration time
ftbteamsconfig.ftbchunks.allow_fake_play:
Treat all fake players as allies to the team
Warning: Setting this to True may allow hostile players to access your territory via any fake players. If unsure, set this to False
ftbteamsconfig.ftbchunks.allow_named_fak:
Treat these fake players as allies to your team
Warning: Adding entries here may allow hostile players to access your territory through these fake players. If unsure, leave it blank
ftbteamsconfig.ftbchunks.allow_fake_play: Allowing fake players using player IDs
Allow fake players with real player IDs to access your territory if the real player is allowed, either as an ally or as a party member. If unsure, set this to True
ftbteamsconfig.ftbchunks.allow_explosion: Can the explosion cause damage to blocks within the territory area?
ftbteamsconfig.ftbchunks.allow_pvp.toolt:
Whether PVP battles between players are allowed in areas of the territory
This feature can only be used if the server configuration: Allow PVP combat in the territory=per_team
There is no guarantee of 100% protection against indirect attacks and the source of damage needs to be attributed to the player
ftbteamsconfig.ftbchunks.allow_mob_grief:
Whether creatures are allowed to destroy blocks in the claimed area
NOTE: Currently only includes endermen; other creatures may be included in the future
Creeper explosions are protected by "Allow Explosions"
ftbteamsconfig.ftbchunks.block_edit_and_: Used when placing, breaking, or interacting with blocks
ftbteamsconfig.ftbchunks.block_edit_mode: Used when placing or breaking blocks
ftbteamsconfig.ftbchunks.block_interact_: Used when right-clicking a block, such as opening a box or using a lever
ftbteamsconfig.ftbchunks.nonliving_entit: Used when left-clicking on non-biological entities (such as paintings, item display frames, etc.)
ftbteamsconfig.ftbchunks.location_mode.t: Control who can see you on the map or minimap (beyond normal vanilla tracking range)
ftbteamsconfig.ftbchunks.claim_visibilit: Control who can see your territory on the map or minimap
ftbchunks.fake_players.tooltip:
CHECK: Check access from fake players just like real players
DENY: Fake players are never allowed
ALLOW: Fake players are always allowed
ftbchunks.max_claimed_chunks: Maximum number of claimed blocks per player
ftbchunks.max_claimed_chunks.tooltip: This default value can be overridden by the ftbchunks.max_claimed permission of FTB Ranks
ftbchunks.max_force_loaded_chunks: Maximum number of forced loading chunks per player
ftbchunks.max_force_loaded_chunks.toolti: This default value can be overridden by the ftbchunks.max_force_loaded permission of FTB Ranks
ftbchunks.force_load_mode.tooltip:
NEVER: Allow chunk force loading only if the team you belong to has at least one online player
ALWAYS: Always allow force loading, even if no players are online
DEFAULT: Forced loading is allowed if at least one player on the team has the ftbchunks.chunk_load_offline permission for FTB Ranks
ftbchunks.disable_protection.tooltip: For private servers where everyone is trusted and the realm is used only for force loading
ftbchunks.pvp_mode: Allow PVP battles within the territory
ftbchunks.pvp_mode.tooltip:
ALWAYS: Allows PVP combat in all territory areas
NEVER: Disable PVP combat in all territory areas
PER_TEAM: Teams can decide whether to allow PVP combat in their territory through team attributes.
ftbchunks.ally_mode: Allow players to change ally settings
ftbchunks.ally_mode.tooltip:
DEFAULT: Determine whether the player is an ally based on the ally status of FTB Teams
FORCED_ALL: Always consider all players allies
FORCED_NONE: Never considers all players allies
ftbchunks.claim_dimension_blacklist.tool:
Dimensions added to the blacklist will be prohibited from claiming blocks.
For example: adding " minecraft:the_end " will disable claiming chunks in the end
Wildcards are allowed, for example: "othermod:*" will match all dimensions added by "othermod"
ftbchunks.claim_dimension_whitelist.tool:
Dimensions added to the whitelist will be allowed to claim blocks. If not empty (nor in the dimension blacklist), the dimension must be in this list
Same syntax as dimension blacklist
ftbchunks.no_wilderness.tooltip: If True, the block must be claimed before building on it
ftbchunks.no_wilderness_dimensions.toolt:
A list of dimension IDs for the block must be declared before modification
For example: Add " minecraft:the_nether " to the list of blocks that need to be claimed in hell
Wildcards are allowed, for example: "othermod:*" will match all dimensions added by "othermod"
ftbchunks.max_idle_days_before_unclaim: Maximum idle time before territory expires
ftbchunks.max_idle_days_before_unclaim.t:
If no team members log in within this number of days, the team's territory will be released
Set this to 0 to disable automatic territorial cancellation
ftbchunks.max_idle_days_before_unforce: Maximum idle time before force loading expires
ftbchunks.max_idle_days_before_unforce.t:
If no team member logs in within this number of days, all force loading blocks will be cancelled.
Set it to 0 to disable automatic cancellation of force loading
ftbchunks.long_range_tracker_interval.to:
The interval, in game ticks, between sending long-range player tracking data to the client.
Lower values mean more frequent updates but increase server load and network traffic; handle this with caution on busy servers
Set it to 0 to disable remote tracking
ftbchunks.protect_unknown_explosions: Protect against explosions from unknown sources
ftbchunks.protect_unknown_explosions.too:
Some explosion sources (such as Ghasts) cannot be determined in code
If this is set to True, damage from these explosions is prevented in protected chunks
ftbchunks.hard_team_claim_limit: Team maximum territory limit - hard limit
ftbchunks.hard_team_claim_limit.tooltip:
A hard maximum territory limit for a team, regardless of number of members or team limit calculation model
The default value is 0 which means no hard limit
ftbchunks.hard_team_force_limit: Team maximum forced load limit - hard limit
ftbchunks.hard_team_force_limit.tooltip:
Hard maximum forced load cap for teams, regardless of number of members or team limit calculation mode
The default value is 0 which means no hard limit
ftbchunks.party_limit_mode.tooltip:
How to calculate team territories and forced loading limits
LARGEST: Limit using members with maximum upper limit
SUM: The limit of the sum of the upper limits of all members
OWNER: Use team owner restrictions only
AVERAGE: Use the average of the upper bounds of all members
ftbchunks.require_game_stage.tooltip: If True, the player must have ftbchunks_mapping game stages to open the map or view the minimap (requires KubeJS and/or Gamestages)
ftbchunks.location_mode_override.tooltip: If True, the team "location visibility" setting is ignored and all players can see each other anywhere on the map
ftbchunks.max_prevented_log_age: Fake players banned access log age
ftbchunks.max_prevented_log_age.tooltip:
Number of days to keep fake player access logs
Note: Not fully implemented feature; will be used in the future to display and control fake player access to your territory
ftbchunks.claim_result.not_enough_power: The block limit has been reached
ftbchunks.claim_result.dimension_forbidd: Claiming territory is prohibited in this dimension
ftbchunks.need_to_claim_chunk: You need to claim this block to interact with the blocks here!
